text_block_list.name: Herb-Savvy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Bouquet-san, pardon me for asking, 
but... are you feeling alright? You're not 
exhausted, are you?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Huh— No, not particularly... Um, is there 
something on your mind—

text_block_list.name: Herb-Savvy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Lavender, chamomile, lemon balm. Lately, 
all the teas I've been drinking have been 
for a restful sleep, so..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Bouquetd'or had unconsciously been 
seeking comfort. It might be best to 
reconsider her future schedule.
